title: Urdu Letters of Mirza Asadullah Khan Ghalib (Khutoot-e-Ghalib)

publication.publisher_or_container: Dev Publishers & Distributors (Rahbar translation); letters written 19th century
publication.edition: Rahbar translation, with a contribution by Annemarie Schimmel

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed Ghalib's Urdu letters and their role in replacing the formal mursala convention with a conversational register; Britannica and Wikipedia records corroborate the informal, humorous, talk-like style and the Rahbar translation. Technique described, no text reproduced.

limitations: Ghalib's register depends on Rekhta/Urdu idiom and Persianised wordplay that English versions flatten; some meaning is irrecoverable in translation.

copyright.notes: Modern translation copyrighted; original Urdu letters public domain; analytical citation only.
